prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【顶会 Rebuttal 实验补全与公平性自证段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。”。请严格按照 `BP47` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L017`（局限性（Limitations）的无损诚实写法：界定适用边界而非自毁贡献），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.
structural_constraints: S1 [直接响应并呈上新表 Direct Fulfilment]：Following your suggestion, we have evaluated [Requested Baselines X and Y] under identical splits and added a parameter-matched variant of our model in Table R3.
S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：TOEFL_Independent 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT23 (托福独立写作满分范文：计算机高等教育应孤立偏向工程编码还是将数学基础与项目实践深度融合)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP33 -> BP34 -> BP36`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: We added the baseline X you asked for. Our model is 0.182 and X is 0.205, so we are still better. Also our model does not have many parameters.
structural_constraints: S1 [直接响应并呈上新表 Direct Fulfilment]：Following your suggestion, we have evaluated [Requested Baselines X and Y] under identical splits and added a parameter-matched variant of our model in Table R3.
S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
domain_context: 长序列 Transformer 稀疏注意力与分块表征
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP48` 与全文样板 `FT23` 的后半部分（`BP39 -> BP40`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: The chart shows the energy consumption from 2000 to 2025. We can see that solar energy went up a lot from 5% to 35%, and coal went down from 60% to 25%. Wind also went up.
structural_constraints: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
